evidence.note: Stands up pages-basic manually in /tmp/testfix, runs `npx vinext dev`, and uses curl probes (status codes, HTML byte counts, /about, /ssr) to observe SSR behavior before running the suite — fast targeted per-subsystem checks.

Parses playwright-env-results.json to see which of 74/325 tests ran/passed and categorizes failures (navigation, ISR, hydration), using this to steer next fixes rather than treating the suite as opaque pass/fail.

Copies app-basic to /tmp/testapp, launches dev server, curls specific routes (metadata-basic, catch-all) to isolate app-router SSR/hydration failures — manual reproduction to observe behavior beyond 'it compiles'.
Root-cause interpretation of API-route failures (notFound() digest, OPTIONS 204, Allow header, cookies) driven from categorized results, then targeted fix.

Tracks pass counts across iterations (47→110→114→132→160) and re-runs full suite as a regression gate after each build; but every test run is the full ~12-min suite — no targeted Playwright spec subsets.

Final verification limited to `npm run build` + dist listing; confirms build path but never manually exercises the production `vinext start` path, and RSC/actions/caching left unprobed by minimal repros.

reasoning: The agent designs a genuine verification loop — manually standing up both fixture apps and using curl probes to observe SSR/route behavior as fast checks, parsing the results JSON to categorize failures by subsystem, and using the full suite as a regression gate with tracked pass-rate deltas — which clearly exceeds the level-5 anchor. It falls short of level 8/10 because it never runs fast targeted test subsets (every actual test run is the slow full suite), never manually verifies the production build/start path, and builds no minimal reproductions for the hard subsystems (RSC, use-cache, actions), which it deferred rather than probed. This places it at a 7, between the level-5 and level-8 anchors.
